# HAPI v0.27.3.2

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Hotfixes the cross-platform `DirectoryTree` storage-fallback test harness so the Linux GitHub Actions unit-test gate uses explicit in-memory Storage implementations instead of jsdom instance spies.
- No runtime behavior, carried PR, upstream base, or artifact contents changed from `v0.27.3.1` apart from the version.

## Compared with the official release

- Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.3.1`, based on official HAPI `v0.27.3`, plus the portable storage-fallback regression test fix.
